cases.question: What are good team tips for Lauma?
cases.answer: Lauma works best in Lunar-Bloom teams with a Hydro character and another Dendro or Hydro unit. [S1] Keep her Elemental Skill on cooldown to maintain Verdant Dew generation. [S1]

cases.question: How can I get free Primogems with redemption codes?
cases.answer: Free Primogem redemption codes are announced during version livestreams and, when redeemed, grant Primogems (and Mora). [S1]

cases.question: How does Lunar-Charged work?
cases.answer:
Lunar-Charged is triggered when Electro meets Hydro (or Hydro meets Electro) on a target while a party member possesses a Moonsign Benediction passive, causing the reaction to replace Electro-Charged and generate a thundercloud. [S1][S4]  
The thundercloud periodically releases Electro damage to nearby enemies that are simultaneously Wet and Electro‑affected, the damage can crit and is based on the total elemental application from all characters involved. [S2]  
Each pulse occurs every 2 seconds, hits all Wet enemies within 5 m that also have Electro, consumes 0.4 GU of both auras per hit, lasts 6 seconds before fading, and its timer resets if another Lunar‑Charged reaction occurs; only one thundercloud can exist at a time. [S3]
